job.title: PROJECT TEST MANAGER
job.content:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Project Test Manager to lead testing, commissioning, system integration, and acceptance activities for data center construction, smart building, and ELV (Extra Low Voltage) projects.

The successful candidate will ensure that all integrated systems meet project specifications, technical standards, and client requirements in terms of functionality, stability, and performance before final handover.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Develop testing and commissioning plans for individual systems and integrated systems.

  2. Lead programming, configuration, and system integration activities, including interface and protocol integration.

  3. Conduct functional, performance, stability, and compatibility testing.

  4. Coordinate system integration testing across multiple ELV and smart building subsystems.

  5. Independently review and verify commissioning results to ensure compliance with technical requirements.

  6. Manage defect tracking, troubleshooting, retesting, and closure until all issues are resolved.

  7. Prepare testing reports, test records, and technical documentation for project acceptance.

  8. Support client acceptance testing, final inspection, and project handover activities.

  9. Maintain testing procedures, test cases, troubleshooting databases, and system integration checklists.

Requirements:

  1. Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering, Automation, Electronics, Telecommunications, or related technical fields.

  2. Minimum 2 years of experience in system testing, commissioning, or system integration.

  3. Knowledge and understanding of:

    • TCP/IP

    • Modbus

    • BACnet

    • ONVIF

    • ELV System Integration

  4. Experience with testing methodologies, commissioning procedures, and defect management.

  5. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

  6. Good documentation, reporting, and coordination capabilities.

  7. Able to read and understand technical documentation and equipment manuals in English.

  8. Willing to travel and support overseas projects when required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Experience in large-scale system integration or construction projects, preferably in data centers, smart buildings, or ELV systems.

  2. Knowledge of programming, system configuration, or automation systems.

  3. Experience participating in complete project testing, commissioning, and acceptance processes.

  4. Relevant testing, automation, or vendor certifications are an advantage.
job.abstract: Lead testing, integration, and acceptance for smart building and ELV projects through final handover.
